summary: San Francisco Bay Area, software developer, strong interest in programming languages (especially Python, JavaScript, and Ruby), expertise in software development and open-source technologies, critical of educational systems and standardized testing, advocates for privacy and data protection, engaged in discussions about mental health and psychology, skeptical of mainstream political narratives, interested in the intersection of technology and society, supports direct funding models for creators (e.g., Kickstarter), critical of corporate influence in education, values self-directed learning and intellectual growth, expresses concern over the implications of artificial intelligence and automation on society.
